title: Three columns
caption: Title and caption up top, exactly three keyed columns below.

first.title: First column
first.prose: Each column has a slug, and its slug is the target a note names it by.

second.title: Second column
second.prose: Columns hold a title and prose, never a position.

third.title: Third column
third.prose: A fourth column is a different layout.

column-target.description: Each column's slug doubles as its target, so a note can point at one column.
